title: Sepulveda Basin Recreation Area – Approval of Brush Clearance and Native
text:
Sepulveda Basin Recreation Area – Approval of Brush Clearance and Native
  Plant Rehabilitation by the Los Angeles Conservation Corps – Categorical
  Exemption from the Provisions of the California Environmental Quality Act
  (CEQA) Pursuant to Article 19, Section 15304 [Minor Public or Private Alterations
  in the Condition of Land, Water, and/or Vegetation Which Do Not Involve
  Removal of Healthy, Mature, Scenic Trees] of California CEQA Guidelines and
  Article III, Section 1, Class 4 of City CEQA Guidelines
